name: DescribeExposedInstanceList

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the server group that you want to query.
You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to query server group IDs
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的服务器分组ID。
您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口查询服务器分组ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the asset that you want to query has vulnerabilities. Valid values:
true: The asset has vulnerabilities.
false: The asset does not have vulnerabilities
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产是否存在漏洞。取值：
true：存在
false：不存在
parameters.name: vul_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the asset that you want to query has baseline weak password risks. Valid values:

true: The asset has baseline weak password risks.
false: The asset does not have baseline weak password risks
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产是否存在基线弱口令风险。取值：

true：存在
false：不存在
parameters.name: health_status

parameters.help_en: The name of the system component exposed on the Internet that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的暴露在互联网中的系统组件名称
parameters.name: exposure_component

parameters.help_en: The exposed port that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的暴露端口
parameters.name: exposure_port

parameters.help_en: The public IP address of the server type or the public network connection address of the database type that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的服务器类型的公网IP或数据库类型的公网连接地址
parameters.name: exposure_ip

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the asset that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的资产实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的资产名称
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The asset type. Valid values:

0: ECS

3: RDS

4: MONGODB

5: RDS-Redis
parameters.name: asset_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the asset that you want to query has Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) risks. Valid values:

true: The asset has CSPM risks.
false: The asset does not have CSPM risks
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产是否存在CSPM风险。取值：

true：存在
false：不存在
parameters.name: cspm_status

parameters.help_en: The type of the exposed component
parameters.name: exposure_component_biz_type
